hexes.ZhInfo: 获得88888卢恩
hexes.EnInfo: Grants 88,888 runes.

hexes.ZhInfo: 降低25%攻击力。全属性提升10点
hexes.EnInfo: Reduces attack power by 25%. Raises all attributes by 10.

hexes.ZhInfo: 承受10倍伤害。提升20%攻击力。你的伤害无视敌人的抗性、防御、减伤率
hexes.EnInfo: Increases damage taken tenfold. Boosts attack power by 20%. Damage dealt ignores enemy resistances, defenses, and damage negation.

hexes.ZhInfo: 施放绝招后，充满绝招量表，45秒冷却
hexes.EnInfo: Fully restores the Art gauge upon using an Ultimate Art. (45-second cooldown.)

hexes.ZhInfo: 你的圣杯瓶数量翻倍，但回复量减半。使用圣杯瓶后，提升5%攻击力，持续15秒
hexes.EnInfo: Doubles the number of Flask of Crimson Tears uses, but halves HP restoration. Using a flask boosts attack power by 5% for 15 seconds.

hexes.ZhInfo: 血量不满时，持续消耗专注值来回复血量。血量全满时，使用圣杯瓶会回复50%专注值
hexes.EnInfo: Continuously consumes FP to restore HP while HP is not at maximum. Using a Flask of Crimson Tears at maximum HP restores 50% of maximum FP.

hexes.ZhInfo: 受到攻击时，由结晶外壳代为承受并破碎。结晶外壳破碎后需要40秒来重新生成
hexes.EnInfo: A crystal shell absorbs an incoming attack and shatters. The shell regenerates after 40 seconds.

hexes.ZhInfo: 获得无限攀爬能力。跳跃攻击的伤害随下落高度提升。消除脚步声。受到攻击时，隐身1秒
hexes.EnInfo: Allows unlimited climbing. Boosts jump attack damage based on fall height. Silences footsteps. Conceals the body for 1 second upon taking damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 你的魔法、祷告还会被视为近战攻击，但只能命中近身敌人，并基于该法术的射程提供吸血、增伤、咏唱时减伤率。法术咏唱变得不易被打断。提升15%近战攻击力
hexes.EnInfo: Sorceries and incantations also count as melee attacks, but can only hit nearby enemies. Spell range determines HP restoration on hit, increased attack power, and damage negation while casting. Makes spell casting harder to interrupt. Boosts melee attack power by 15%.

hexes.ZhInfo: 提升攻击成功时的冲击力
hexes.EnInfo: Boosts the impact of successful attacks.

hexes.ZhInfo: 血量偏低时，在10秒内加快行动并提升60%减伤率，60秒冷却
hexes.EnInfo: Increases action speed and boosts damage negation by 60% for 10 seconds when HP is low. (60-second cooldown.)

hexes.ZhInfo: 强化后跃的闪避能力。后跃攻击进行反击或正面处决敌人时，回复25%绝招量表。翻滚或受到损伤时，损失30%绝招量表。你的后跃攻击随绝招量表提升最多200%伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Improves backstep evasion. Successful backstep attacks against enemies whose stance is not broken, and critical hits from the front, each fill 25% of the Art gauge. Dodge rolls and damage taken each deplete 30% of the Art gauge. Boosts backstep attack damage by up to 200%, based on the current Art gauge.

hexes.ZhInfo: 战技专注值消耗降低100%。每次施放战技后，重铸该武器的战技
hexes.EnInfo: Reduces skill FP consumption by 100%. Using a skill reforges the skill of that armament.

hexes.ZhInfo: 标记自己时，形成熔岩，短暂延时后爆发。期间每次标记自己都会为这颗熔岩提升伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Marking one's own position generates roiling lava. Further marks of one's own position before eruption increase its damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 你无需钥匙就能打开监牢，且释放的敌人更加多样。攻略监牢后，不会生成赐福，但你可以重复打开同一个监牢。每座封印监牢最多开启5次
hexes.EnInfo: Allows evergaols to be opened without a Stonesword Key, releasing a wider variety of enemies. Defeating the prisoners does not create a Site of Grace, but allows the same evergaol to be opened again. Each evergaol can be opened up to five times.

hexes.ZhInfo: 血量上限提升50%。减伤率降低30%。突刺抗性降低100%。阵亡或濒死时爆炸，对附近敌人造成等同于你血量上限的伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Raises maximum HP by 50%. Reduces damage negation by 30%. Reduces resistance to piercing attacks by 100%. Triggers an explosion upon death or entering near-death, dealing damage equal to maximum HP to nearby enemies.

hexes.ZhInfo: 储存最近打倒的强大灵魂，优先保留血量上限更高的灵魂。施放【不死行军】时，召唤其灵体，短时间内为你作战
hexes.EnInfo: Stores the soul of a powerful enemy defeated by the party, replacing it only with a soul of higher maximum HP. Using [Immortal March] consumes the stored soul to summon a spirit that fights alongside the summoner. The spirit loses 1/60 of its maximum HP each second and deals 25% of its original damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 魔法、祷告蓄力时，每秒回复30点精力值
hexes.EnInfo: Restores 30 stamina per second while charging sorceries or incantations.

hexes.ZhInfo: 触媒的副法术消耗降低100%，并且施法后变为随机新法术
hexes.EnInfo: Reduces FP consumption of a catalyst’s secondary spell by 100%. After casting, replaces it with a random new spell.

hexes.ZhInfo: 偶尔在周围生成黄金法阵
hexes.EnInfo: Occasionally creates golden magic circles nearby.

hexes.ZhInfo: 提升冲刺后的跳跃距离。可以叠加最多三层。每层提升50%跳跃攻击力
hexes.EnInfo: Extends jumping distance after starting a sprint. Stacks up to three times. Each stack increases jump attack power by 50%.

hexes.ZhInfo: 双手共持武器的攻击可以招架敌人的攻击。成功招架时的防御反击不消耗精力，且伤害提升100%
hexes.EnInfo: Attacks grant a guarding effect while two-handing a weapon. After successfully guarding with this effect, guard counters consume no stamina and deal 100% more damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 在夜雨中摆出姿势“雨啊！”时，持续回复血量。完整摆出姿势后，回血效果可以在姿势退出后继续维持15秒，并提升25%攻击力，持续至离开夜雨。60秒冷却
hexes.EnInfo: Gradually restores HP while performing the “It’s Raining!” gesture in the Night’s Tide. Completing the gesture allows HP restoration to persist for 15 seconds after ending it, and raises attack power by 25% until leaving the Night’s Tide. 60-second cooldown.

hexes.ZhInfo: 攻击成功时，对自己造成等同于血量上限5%的损伤
hexes.EnInfo: Landing attacks causes damage to self equal to 5% of maximum HP.

hexes.ZhInfo: 获得两支魅惑树枝。使用魅惑树枝60秒后，重新获得一支魅惑树枝。短时间内连续使用时，仅返还第一次使用的树枝
hexes.EnInfo: Grants two Bewitching Branches. Using a Bewitching Branch grants another after 60 seconds. Only the first use during this interval grants a replacement.

validation: Mighty excludes Revenant/Recluse from random and preferred rewards. Texts updated; runtime projectile handling and regulation unchanged. Gameplay pending.
